Whether you’re facing a difficult season, spending Thanksgiving away from family, watching your budget, or you simply don’t feel like cooking this year — come. Just come we want to serve you. events.title: Winter Workshop l – Handmade Holiday Frames & Cards
events.description: Create heartfelt handmade gifts just in time for the holiday season! Young artists will design and decorate their own picture frame and matching handmade greeting cards using paint, collage materials, embellishments, stamps, and festive mixed-media techniques. Perfect for gifting to family members, friends, or keeping as a special holiday memory. Students will enjoy holiday treats, festive music, and a cozy creative atmosphere while making meaningful handmade gifts. Participants will also get to choose a festive gift bag to take their projects home in if they would like to gift their creations. This workshop is a great opportunity for parents and caregivers to get some last-minute holiday shopping done while kids create and celebrate at Blue Line Arts. All materials included. events.title: Winter Workshop lll – Trinket Box & Handmade Cards
events.description: Get creative and make meaningful handmade gifts in this festive holiday workshop! Students will decorate their own trinket box using paint, gems, collage, metallic finishes, and other fun embellishments, creating a unique keepsake box perfect for jewelry, treasures, or special notes. Participants will also design handmade holiday cards to complete their personalized gift set. Students will enjoy holiday treats and a cheerful seasonal atmosphere while creating personalized gifts to take home. Participants will also get to choose a festive gift bag for their projects if they would like to gift their creations to someone special. Parents and caregivers can also take advantage of the workshop time to get some last-minute holiday shopping done while kids create at Blue Line Arts. All materials included.
